# Anthropic - Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships briefing packet
| Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships | $315,000–$380,000 OTE | Reports to Partnerships / GTM leadership (partner ecosystem and enterprise adoption context) |

## JD Complement
Anthropic is scaling a safety-oriented AI platform through enterprises and their trusted implementation partners. The strategic question is not simply how to broaden access to Claude, but how to ensure partner-delivered outcomes remain
credible, governed, and repeatable.

This role sits in the operating gap between frontier-model capability and enterprise execution. Its leverage comes from helping external technical teams turn platform access into durable customer value while preserving clear standards for
quality, security, and responsible use.

The core tension is controlled ecosystem scale: avoid a high-touch, bespoke delivery model while preventing fragmented solution patterns, uneven partner capability, and unstructured field feedback.

## Company DNA & Operating Model
Anthropic is a San Francisco-headquartered AI public benefit corporation founded in 2021. Its stated orientation emphasizes AI systems that are reliable, interpretable, and steerable.

The company combines frontier AI research, safety work, platform development, and enterprise commercialization. Claude is positioned for business users and developers working on analysis, writing, coding, and complex operational problems.

Anthropic’s commercial model appears to blend direct enterprise engagement with partner-assisted reach. Cloud, technology, and services firms can extend market access, implementation capacity, and specialized industry expertise.

The operating challenge is to make enterprise AI useful in real workflows without reducing trust, governance, or deployment quality to an afterthought.

## Company Strategy & Operating Pressure
Anthropic’s public enterprise materials frame adoption as more than a model-selection decision. Technical configuration, organizational launch, user behavior, governance, and continuing adoption all affect whether a deployment creates
durable value.

That creates pressure for a consistent enterprise story across direct and partner-led routes. Customers need practical pathways from experimentation to governed production use, while internal teams need visibility into recurring delivery
patterns and friction points.

Safety positioning can be commercially differentiating, particularly where customers care about dependable behavior, security, and oversight. It also raises the standard for partner communications, solution design, and implementation
discipline.

A central strategic question is where standardization should win, where vertical adaptation is valuable, and when field experience should trigger deeper product or engineering involvement.

## Leadership & Stakeholder Map
Anthropic’s stakeholder environment likely spans commercial, technical, product, and safety-oriented functions. Success requires credibility with people who view the same customer situation through different lenses: revenue, adoption,
architecture, reliability, and product learning.

Key internal stakeholder groups include:
- Partnerships and GTM leaders shaping cloud, technology, and services-partner growth.
- Enterprise account teams seeking stronger coverage, technical confidence, and delivery capacity.
- Product and engineering groups that require validated patterns rather than isolated requests.
- Security, administration, and adoption stakeholders focused on operational readiness.
- Safety-oriented functions that influence responsible deployment boundaries.

The position should function as an operating bridge across these groups. Strong leadership will create shared decision rights, escalation paths, and reusable mechanisms rather than relying on relationship-by-relationship coordination.

## AI, Data, Platform, Architecture Signals
Anthropic describes Claude as safe, accurate, and secure, alongside a broader emphasis on reliability, interpretability, and steerability. These themes make architecture quality inseparable from commercial credibility.

Its enterprise offering highlights security, compliance, and support for both business teams and technical builders. Accordingly, customer architecture conversations should address governance, user workflows, implementation readiness,
administrative controls, and measurable outcomes in addition to application integration.

Anthropic’s enterprise materials also address change management and launch. This suggests that successful use depends on operating-model design, not merely technical access.

The company’s guidance around advancing from pilots toward production-ready agents is an especially relevant signal. Partners will need reusable patterns that help customers progress without sacrificing review, control, or maintainability.

## Partnership / Ecosystem Motion
Anthropic publicly identifies cloud, technology, and services organizations as parts of its partner network. This makes the ecosystem a meaningful route to customer reach, domain expertise, and implementation capacity.

The highest-value motion is likely not a passive referral model. It is an ecosystem in which external firms can confidently position, design, and support Claude-based solutions while Anthropic retains coherent standards and learns from
repeated field use.

High-value ecosystem mechanisms may include:
- Cloud-aligned technical patterns that fit enterprise environments and procurement paths.
- Practice-building programs that help services firms develop client-ready AI offerings.
- Integration approaches that place Claude inside established enterprise workflows.
- Shared opportunity support for complex accounts where partner credibility or delivery capacity matters.
- A structured path for converting deployment signals into product and commercial learning.

The decisive test is partner independence with accountability: external teams should create strong outcomes without requiring constant intervention or creating inconsistent customer experiences.

## Recent Events & Urgency
Anthropic’s visible enterprise resources emphasize moving organizations beyond initial AI experimentation. That raises the importance of partners that can make adoption operational, repeatable, and appropriately governed.

Its attention to administration, rollout, and change management indicates that enterprise customers need more than technical demonstrations. They need a credible path to sustained use across teams, systems, and internal controls.

The combination of partner positioning and enterprise-adoption guidance signals a commercialization phase where repeatability is increasingly important. The near-term pressure is to convert ecosystem reach into high-quality customer
outcomes
and actionable product intelligence.

## apps_rg Positioning Themes (targeting only, not proof)
- Building technical partner motions that translate AI platform capability into repeatable enterprise outcomes.
- Creating scalable enablement, solution patterns, and governance for external delivery organizations.
- Balancing strategic opportunity support with durable partner autonomy.
- Turning architecture observations from the field into useful product and commercial decisions.
- Leading across ambiguity where customer needs, partner incentives, and platform limits intersect.
- Advancing enterprise AI from exploratory work into managed, durable operating use.
- Protecting trust, security, and solution quality while increasing ecosystem leverage.
- Coaching senior technical leaders who can engage executives and hands-on practitioners.

## apps_lic Outreach Angles (targeting only, not proof)
- Its enterprise materials frame adoption as organizational change as well as technical implementation.

## Do Not Use As Proof
The JD and this briefing are targeting inputs only. Candidate claims must come from the governed resume and proof graph.

Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships
San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA

About Anthropic

Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As the Manager of the Partnerships Applied AI Solutions Architect team, you will drive adoption of frontier AI by enabling deployment of Anthropic's products (Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, API) through our Global and Regional System Integrators, cloud partners (AWS, GCP, Azure), and strategic technology partners.

You will build and lead a team of Partner Solutions Architects, establish processes and best practices for partner-led pre-sales engagements, and represent Anthropic as the technical lead on its most important partnerships. In collaboration with Sales, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering, you will help partners incorporate leading-edge AI into their practices, accelerate indirect revenue, and execute long-term GTM strategy while maintaining our best-in-class safety standards.

Responsibilities

    Team Leadership & Development: Hire, manage, and mentor a team of Partner Solutions Architects. Set goals, run reviews, and coach each team member toward high productivity and career growth.
    Strategic Technical Partnership: Act as the senior technical thought partner to Anthropic's GTM partnerships team. Co-build partner strategy with aligned GTM leadership, drive key programs, and align cross-functional stakeholders (Sales, Product, Engineering) behind partner outcomes.
    Partner Enablement & Ecosystem: Embed your team with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, troubleshoot, and evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities. Represent Anthropic at partner events (GSI workshops, AWS/GCP summits, hackathons) and contribute technical content and thought leadership.
    Joint Solution Development: Lead partners in identifying high-value, industry-specific GenAI applications. Develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures and best practices to accelerate time to deployment.
    Customer Deal Support: Own the technical portion of partner-led pre-sales engagements. Intervene directly on strategic deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep solution architecture guidance.
    Product Feedback: Gather and validate feedback on Anthropic's products from partner deployments and deliver it to Product and Engineering to inform roadmap and partner strategy.

You may be a good fit if you have

    7+ years in technical customer-facing or partner-facing roles (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner SE, TAM).
    3+ years managing pre-sales or partner-facing technical teams; comfortable building foundational teams in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
    Track record building and scaling partnerships with GSIs (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, TCS, Infosys) and/or cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).
    Deep understanding of partner-led selling and delivery: indirect revenue models, enablement at scale, and joint GTM motions.
    Technical depth in enterprise AI deployments: LLM architecture, prompt engineering, evaluation, API integrations, and production use cases.
    Exceptional communication and executive presence; able to build trusted relationships with C-suite, partner leadership, and engineering teams alike.
    A love of teaching and mentoring, and a passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI.

Strong candidates may also have

    5+ years leading partner-facing SA teams through hypergrowth, including developing both senior and junior talent.
    Direct experience helping GSIs or consultancies build their AI/ML practice - enablement programs, certification paths, joint solution development.

Compensation

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role's On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary: $315,000 - $380,000 USD

credible, governed, and repeatable.

This role sits in the operating gap between frontier-model capability and enterprise execution. Its leverage comes from helping external technical teams turn platform access into durable customer value while preserving clear standards for

The core tension is controlled ecosystem scale: avoid a high-touch, bespoke delivery model while preventing fragmented solution patterns, uneven partner capability, and unstructured field feedback.

Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships
San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA

About Anthropic

Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As the Manager of the Partnerships Applied AI Solutions Architect team, you will drive adoption of frontier AI by enabling deployment of Anthropic's products (Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, API) through our Global and Regional System Integrators, cloud partners (AWS, GCP, Azure), and strategic technology partners.

You will build and lead a team of Partner Solutions Architects, establish processes and best practices for partner-led pre-sales engagements, and represent Anthropic as the technical lead on its most important partnerships. In collaboration with Sales, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering, you will help partners incorporate leading-edge AI into their practices, accelerate indirect revenue, and execute long-term GTM strategy while maintaining our best-in-class safety standards.

Responsibilities

    Team Leadership & Development: Hire, manage, and mentor a team of Partner Solutions Architects. Set goals, run reviews, and coach each team member toward high productivity and career growth.
    Strategic Technical Partnership: Act as the senior technical thought partner to Anthropic's GTM partnerships team. Co-build partner strategy with aligned GTM leadership, drive key programs, and align cross-functional stakeholders (Sales, Product, Engineering) behind partner outcomes.
    Partner Enablement & Ecosystem: Embed your team with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, troubleshoot, and evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities. Represent Anthropic at partner events (GSI workshops, AWS/GCP summits, hackathons) and contribute technical content and thought leadership.
    Joint Solution Development: Lead partners in identifying high-value, industry-specific GenAI applications. Develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures and best practices to accelerate time to deployment.
    Customer Deal Support: Own the technical portion of partner-led pre-sales engagements. Intervene directly on strategic deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep solution architecture guidance.
    Product Feedback: Gather and validate feedback on Anthropic's products from partner deployments and deliver it to Product and Engineering to inform roadmap and partner strategy.

You may be a good fit if you have

    7+ years in technical customer-facing or partner-facing roles (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner SE, TAM).
    3+ years managing pre-sales or partner-facing technical teams; comfortable building foundational teams in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
    Track record building and scaling partnerships with GSIs (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, TCS, Infosys) and/or cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).
    Deep understanding of partner-led selling and delivery: indirect revenue models, enablement at scale, and joint GTM motions.
    Technical depth in enterprise AI deployments: LLM architecture, prompt engineering, evaluation, API integrations, and production use cases.
    Exceptional communication and executive presence; able to build trusted relationships with C-suite, partner leadership, and engineering teams alike.
    A love of teaching and mentoring, and a passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI.

Strong candidates may also have

    5+ years leading partner-facing SA teams through hypergrowth, including developing both senior and junior talent.
    Direct experience helping GSIs or consultancies build their AI/ML practice - enablement programs, certification paths, joint solution development.

Compensation

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role's On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary: $315,000 - $380,000 USD
